file_stem: RWB E1 032 Automatic attach from the OCR intake
title: Automatic attach from the OCR intake
goal: Documents attach to their case automatically when exactly one open case matches; unclear ones go to a person
why: Mailroom and branch scans stop waiting for manual filing. The case or account number found in the text is resolved through the case directory.
triggers: Reviewer resolves held items on SCR-31

ace.note: account_code: an account number in the text -> open cases

writes.note: DOCATT with classifier version + match method

reads.note: find by case or account number

stores: rwb-docs container (PENDING docs held); PII access log on intake reads; DocumentStored event (EV-16)

path.text: DocumentStore.store or held for a person

rules: BR1: exactly one open case -> attach with no person involved
BR3: no match, several, conflict, closed case or no type -> a person decides
BR4: below CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD -> stored for review, not write-once
BR5: DOCATT is logged before the store
risks: No readable case or account number -> NO_MATCH (MSG-P5-003)
Decision log fails -> auto stays PENDING, manual gets 503 (MSG-P7-003)
example: Court notice with case ID RW-2026-000123, classified COURT_NOTICE 0.93 by CLS-1.0 (threshold 0.80)
-> stored on RW-2026-000123, source SCAN, review_status NOT_NEEDED
